issue_context.title: Cloud hangs startup if internet is down.
issue_context.body:
## The problem
Home assistant startup hangs, I think it's a DNS resolution issue, I suspect the Home assistant container started up before pi-hole did when I rebooted the host.

"Home Assistant is starting, not everything will be available until it is finished."

## Environment


- Home Assistant 0.116.4
- Docker (Debian 10 Host)
- Cloud


## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
```
#
# Configure a default setup of Home Assistant (frontend, api, etc)
default_config:

# Text to speech
tts:
  - platform: google_translate

group: !include groups.yaml
automation: !include automations.yaml
script: !include scripts.yaml
scene: !include scenes.yaml
light: !include lights.yaml

tplink:
 discovery: false
 switch:
  - host: xxx
  - host: xxx
  - host: xxx
  - host: xxx
 strip:
  - host: xxx
```

    addrs = await \

    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/socket.py", line 918, in getaddrinfo
    for res in _socket.getaddrinfo(host, port, family, type, proto, flags):
socket.gaierror: [Errno -3] Try again

The above exception was the direct cause of the following exception:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/setup.py", line 213, in _async_setup_component

  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/aiohttp/connector.py", line 858, in _create_connection
    _, proto = await self._create_direct_connection(
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.8/site-packages/aiohttp/connector.py", line 971, in _create_direct_connection

## Additional information

Restarting the Homeassitant container with no config changes worked, but ideally having DNS or internet access being unavailable shouldn't cause startup to hang.
comments:
Hey there @home-assistant/cloud, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`cloud`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L77) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

review_comments: This will run forever if we always get a ClientError, we should at least log a warning and/or limit this
I will now print a warning if it's retrying and HA is not running yet. That way if internet is still being established on the machine, it won't log.
